messages:
emma (docs): quick sync — product wants a short deprecation banner + migration guide for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. who can own the docs PR?
raj (eng): I can draft migration steps. need canonical list of breaking changes from SDK.
nina (sdk): Key breaks: header change Authorization -> x-rw-api-key, endpoint rename /v1/generate -> /v2/responses, payload prompt -> input, and streaming frame format update. will paste minimal snippets.
emma (docs): include curl + ts examples, a 1-line banner (<90 chars), and an FAQ entry for header grep. also need email subject suggestions.
sophie (product): schedule: retire alias redwood/text-legacy on 2026-06-10 23:59UTC. public notice window 30 days from 2026-05-11. doc must include fallback/contract exceptions.
raj (eng): infra ok for 30 days. will add oncall verification steps to the checklist.
nina (sdk): snippets:
```bash
# v1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# v2
curl -X POST -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
emma (docs): great — i'll keep a 2-line quickstart in banner page and put full examples in migration appendix. add token-delta note and troubleshooting table.
sophie (product): banner draft: "Deprecation: v1 text endpoints retiring 2026-06-10. See migration guide." subject draft: "Action required: Update to Redwood text v2 endpoints"
deploy-bot: text-v2 canary deployed to us-east-1 at 2026-05-04T12:04:00Z.
emma (docs): action items: 1) raj opens docs PR with migration guide + banner copy, 2) nina updates SDK README linking to docs, 3) sophie finalizes announcement timing. target merge: 2026-05-09. please drop PR links here when open and react with :thumbsup: when reviewed. thanks!
